admin.title: Library maintenance
admin.subtitle: Tidy up albums and artists that got orphaned by tag mistakes. Track files are left alone.
admin.authRequired: Log in from Settings to use the maintenance tools.
admin.fetchFailed: Could not load the library state.
admin.cleanupHint: Only albums with zero tracks and artists with no links are removed. Tracks and audio files stay intact.
admin.cleanupConfirm: Delete {count} empty albums / orphan artists? This cannot be undone.

emptyAlbums.title: Albums without tracks
emptyAlbums.description: Album rows that no longer have any tracks attached — leftovers from file deletion or missing album tags.

orphanArtists.title: Unreferenced artists
orphanArtists.description: Artist rows that no track or album refers to anymore.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage server connection and personal preferences.

language.title: Display language
language.description: Choose the language for menus and descriptions.

timezone.title: Statistics timezone
timezone.description: Charts and stats use this timezone for day and hour grouping.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Switch between light and dark mode.

deploy.title: Deploy · version
deploy.description: Check whether this UI and the API server came from the same npm run deploy.
deploy.noBuildInfo: No build-info.json — run npm run deploy and deploy:restart
deploy.noDeployInfo: No deploy timestamp. Rebuild with npm run deploy.
deploy.versionMismatch: Version mismatch (frontend {frontend} · backend {backend}). Confirm deploy and server restart.
deploy.buildsInSync: Frontend and backend appear from the same deploy (within 10 minutes).
deploy.buildSkew: {newer}. Confirm you ran npm run deploy and deploy:restart together.

server.title: Server connection
server.description: Enter your Lazidrome backend URL and master password.
server.urlHint: Leave empty when using npm run dev on localhost:3000 (Vite proxies /api to 5294).

lastfm.title: Last.fm (server)
lastfm.description: API keys and scrobbling are configured in the backend .env, not in the browser.
lastfm.enrichOff: No LASTFM_API_KEY — add to .env and restart the server
lastfm.scrobbleOn: API key, secret, and session key are all set
lastfm.scrobbleOff: Scrobbling needs API key, secret, and session key
lastfm.loginHint: Log in to see Last.fm status on the server.

stats.title: Stats
stats.description: View playback and listening data by period. Bar labels are approximate listen time.
stats.authEmpty: Log in under Settings to view statistics.
stats.timezoneNote: Grouped in {statsZone}. Play times are stored on the server ({storageZone}).
stats.listenNote: Listen time is replays × track file length; actual playback position is not stored.
stats.timeHint: Before 8:00 and after 22:00 are grouped; 8:00–21:00 are hourly.

charts.title: Charts
charts.description: Most played tracks by period. Sort: period plays → rating → all-time plays.
charts.authEmpty: Log in under Settings to view charts.
charts.noPlaysYet: No plays in this period yet. Listen to a track to start the chart.

auth.emptyDefault: Log in under Settings to use your library.
